cardOverview.overviewText: An upgraded First Power Plus variant delivering higher rewards, lifestyle perks, and milestone bonuses for regular spenders.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: 25% off on movie tickets upto ₹100, once every month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the District app once every month. Book movie tickets and pay using your IDFC First Power Plus credit card to get 25% off up to ₹100. For support, contact IDFC FIRST Bank customer care at 1860 267 3333

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Get personal accident cover worth ₹2 lakh and lost card liability cover worth ₹25,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to IDFC FIRST Bank Customer Care at 1800 10 888 or email banker@idfcfirstbank.com
